versions.changelog:
Initial release of a restructured SEO knowledge base and workflow skill.

- Major content overhaul: replaced previous workflow-focused, English-language references with a new, modular set of German-language SEO files based on Google Search Central sources.
- Improved structure: granular references for fundamentals, crawling, ranking display, monitoring, and web-specific SEO workflows; now organized for more precise advice.
- Clear usage and setup guidance: detailed installation, eligibility, and AI usage instructions in README and SKILL files.
- Added explicit technical requirements and primary-source citation preferences; no bundled plugin.
- Enhanced compliance and transparency: removed all platform-violating tactics and secret/token references, focusing on best practice and audit-driven recommendations.
